attempts.title: baseline: reference get_scan.c unchanged (scan-pid list + sampled LFU w/ index-block bonus) to calibrate where references land
reference s3fifo.c unchanged (landscape mapping)
reference mglru.c unchanged (landscape mapping)
s3fifo + scan_pids: scan-thread accesses don't bump freq (sequential scans touch each page many times), scan-added pages bypass ghost check and get no ghost entry unless a GET touched them
s3fifo + correlated-reference period: accesses within 2ms of the last counted one don't bump freq (filters in-scan repeat touches of the same page, keeps cross-scan/GET reuse)
noise check: plain s3fifo re-run (identical to 7c3ef53d except trailing comment)
s3fifo with small queue 1/10 of cache instead of 1/15 (canonical S3-FIFO ratio)
s3fifo small 1/10 + ghost map 2x cache size (remember more evicted pages so quick re-references go straight to main)
s3fifo 1/10 + ghost 2x, but scan-thread re-adds never promote via ghost (test: does scan ghost-flooding of main cause the eval-8 throughput loss?)
gated-ghost s3fifo with ghost 4x cache (only GET-thread re-adds use ghost, so remember more GET reuse)
gated-ghost s3fifo (ghost 4x) with small queue 1/8 of cache (bigger small queue cut I/O in eval 7; throughput has slack now)
gated-ghost s3fifo (4x, small 1/10): scan-thread ghost hits now enter main at the HEAD (low priority) instead of staying in small; GET ghost hits still main tail
structural attempt 1/3 on GET-aware aging: gated-ghost s3fifo (4x, 1/10) + get_touched bit; main CLOCK decrements scan-only pages by 2, GET-touched by 1
structural attempt 2/3 on GET-aware aging: milder penalty - scan-only pages freq cap 2 (GET-touched cap 3), normal decrement
structural attempt 3/3 on GET-aware aging: cap-2 for scan-only pages, but get_touched set ONLY at add time (no scan_pids lookup in folio_accessed) - tests hook-overhead hypothesis
hook-overhead attempt 1/3: gated-ghost s3fifo (b631bf1b) with cheaper folio_accessed - drop watchlist lookup (metadata lookup implies relevance), plain read/store instead of atomic, no-op at cap 3
drift check: re-run gated-ghost s3fifo b631bf1b unchanged (eval16's cheaper hook gave 1247 vs 1274 ops/s; is that real or machine drift?)
gated-ghost s3fifo (b631bf1b) + LevelDB index-block protection: last page of each file promoted from small to main and skipped by main CLOCK eviction (eviction-path only, hot hook unchanged)
tune probe: reference sampling.c unchanged (landscape point + learn what --tune does on this grader)
variance check: 3rd run of gated-ghost s3fifo b631bf1b (runs so far: 1273.7/311.1MB, 1257.4/305.6MB)
ablation: gated-ghost s3fifo (small 1/10) with ghost back to 1x cache - is the bigger ghost load-bearing or is the thread gate alone enough?
gated-ghost s3fifo, ghost 2x, scan-added pages that never reached main get NO ghost entry (eval21 ablation: 1x gated ghost = -0.90, suggesting scan evictions crowd GET history out of the ghost)
b7395753 + GET-added pages promote small->main on first reuse (freq>0); scan-added pages still need freq>1
gated-ghost s3fifo b631bf1b with ghost map as common (global) LRU instead of BPF_F_NO_COMMON_LRU: per-CPU partitions may leave most ghost capacity unused when kswapd does the evicting
landscape: reference lhd.c unchanged (last unmapped reference policy)
gated-ghost s3fifo (61054f8b) with freq cap 2 instead of 3: fewer CLOCK passes in main, faster turnover of formerly-hot pages
repeat #2 of freq-cap-2 gated-ghost s3fifo (e573de75: 1259.7 ops/s, 308.4 MB) to compare mean vs b631bf1b (3 runs: mean 1268 ops/s, 309.0 MB)
real submission of freq-cap-2 gated-ghost s3fifo (2 tune runs: 0.9967 / 0.9983, mean 306.9 MB vs base 309.0 MB; throughput saturated at ~1259)
